title: Only include scopeId on link-local addresses when using native transport

timeline.message:
Only include scopeId on link-local addresses when using native transport

Motivation:

We should only include the scopeId when the address is link-local or the scopeId was explicit something different then 0. Otherwise we might get into trouble if people don't expect it included

Modifications:

Ensure we only construct a InetAddress with scopeId if its a non link-local address or it was explicit set by the underlying OS

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/discussions/14184
timeline.author: Norman Maurer

timeline.author: Norman Maurer

timeline.body: This was found as part of https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/HBASE-27304
Reading through the man page, it sounds like scope is _only_ supported for link-local addresses. Does that means we should omit the scope, even non-zero scope, if the address is not link local?

reply.body: I asked myself the same but then decided against it as we should only fill it with non-zero when the underlying OS tells us so..

timeline.body: While I'm approving, I'm certainly not an expert in ipv6 details so if you're not confident maybe wait for a more authoritative review before shipping.
